scope: A dimension-independent bridge from membership in the actual signed/permuted rational span of (W,0) and the last coordinate axis to the full positive integer speed list (A W,b), retaining multiplicities and permutation. A base coordinate equal to one proves integrality of the scale. For a primitive actual speed list below 1/q, with q at least four and every base residue nonzero modulo q, the existing unbounded product-family arithmetic forces the exact family W ++ [q*s] with s positive. No geometric exhaustiveness, numerical coverage, or unconditional spectrum classification is claimed.
